text_block_list.name: Kyouka
text_block_list.text: Seriously... asking me out of nowhere to help clean your room, just what are you thinking...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう……
いきなり部屋のお片付けを手伝ってほしいなんて、
何を考えてるんですか。

text_block_list.name: Kyouka
text_block_list.text: You're always late to your appointments, your homework piles up, and you spend so much time taking care of others...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたはいつも約束に遅刻してきたり、
宿題をため込んでたり、
世話が焼けるんですから……

text_block_list.name: Kyouka
text_block_list.text: He doesn't even remember what day is today, does he? ...And here I was hoping a little bit for the opposite...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これじゃ、
今日が何の日かも覚えてないよね。
……ちょっとだけ期待、
してたんだけどな……

text_block_list.name: Kyouka
text_block_list.text: AAAHHHHHHHHHH?! W-W-What do you think you're doing?! T-That scared me! I ended up yelling!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃあ～っ！？
なっ、
何するんですか！
びび、
びっくりしました！　
大きな声をあげちゃったじゃないですか！

text_block_list.name: Kyouka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh... You remembered about it? Then the reason you called me over was...
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっ？
あ……
覚えてて、
くれたんですか？
じゃあ、
私を呼んだのは……

text_block_list.name: Kyouka
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...! Ehehe... you really surprised me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます……！
えへへ……
サプライズ、
されちゃいました。

text_block_list.name: Kyouka
text_block_list.text: B-But! You totally startled me, you know! That kind of thing is NOT okay, reflect on your actions! Look, my legs gave out and I can't even move now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でっ、
でも！　
びっくりしたんですからね！
驚かすのはよくありませんっ、
反省してください！
ほら見てください、
腰が抜けて
動けなくなっちゃったじゃないですか！

text_block_list.name: Kyouka
text_block_list.text: HYAAH?! And now what are you doing all of a sudden? I know I said I couldn't move, but this isn't the right solution...! Y-You suspicious~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひ
ゃっ！？　
急になにをっ？
動けないと言っても、
そこまでじゃ……！
へっ、
へんた──

text_block_list.name: Kyouka
text_block_list.text: ...No. It's a princess carry, so he's more like a prince...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ううん。
お姫様抱っこだから、
王子様みたい──

text_block_list.name: Kyouka
text_block_list.text: ...But still, this is way too heart-pounding, I can't take it! *Breathe in*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──だけどやっぱり
これはドキドキしすぎてダメです！
すーっ。

text_block_list.name: Kyouka
text_block_list.text: YOU SUSPICIOUS PERVEEEEEEEEEEERT!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: へんたいふしんしゃーーーーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Ah, my buddy. What's the big idea calling me out here all of a sudden?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おぅ、
ダチ公。
急に呼びだしやがって、
どうしたぃ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: The view? ...Well, yeah, can't deny it. Up this high, the sightlines are damn good. The sky wind's biting cold, but it's about time it dies down. Not harsh enough to complain about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
景色ィ？
……
まァ、
こう高ぇと
見晴らしはいいな。
空っ風が冷てぇが、
そろそろ吹き収めだ。
邪険にするほどじゃねぇや。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Come to think of it, I visited Mei at the hospital during this time of the year. Had shorter legs back then. Plodding along, step by step...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あァ。
冥の病院通ってたのも、
こんな季節だったっけ。
今よか短ぇ足で、
えっちらおっちら……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Nah. Forget it. Just old memories. Don't mind me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや、
なんでもねぇ。
昔の話だ。
忘れてくんな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: By the way... what's with you today? What kind of mood brought this on?
text_block_list.orig_text:
てか。
お前さん結局、
今日は一体どういう風の吹き回しだぃ？

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Ah... right. That's also something that happens around this time of the year... ...Wait. Did I ever even tell you my birthday? ...Eh, whatever. Would be bad manners to brush it off now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
そういやもうそんな時期……
……って、
お前さんに誕生日なんざ教えたか？
……
まァいいか。
無碍にするのも
野暮ってもんだ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Besides, I like this view. It's not a "thing" you can hold... but even after I'm dead, it'll be a part of "me".
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
景色
ってのも気に入ったぜ。
物と違って、
おっ死んだ後でも有意義なとことかな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Thanks, {0}. Birthdays are usually nothing but gloomy celebrations for me, but... The wind you carried along for my sake cleared my heart, if only a little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんがとよ、
{0}。
誕生日なんざ、
俺にとっちゃ曇るばっかの厄日だが……
お前さんが運んでくれた風のお陰で、
ちったぁ胸が
スーッ
としたぜ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey. If I keep getting myself indebted to you like this, I won't have enough spare change left for the ferryman of the departed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい。
ンな恩を売られるばっかりじゃ、
三途の川の渡し守への六文銭まで足りなくなっちまわァ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Well... I guess I should worry about the ship I'm on with you right now. If you've got that much free time, {0}, then come visit my sister's grave with me~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま……
それこそ、
乗りかかった船か。
そんなに暇なら{0}よ、
俺の墓参りに付き合いな──
